verdicts.reason: A: the sage circle has come apart from the can and sits as a stray blob behind the body copy, badges and CTA in the bottom-left. That is an unintended collision, and the can now floats on bare background, which loses the original's framing. B keeps the circle behind the can as in the original and has a clean top-to-bottom story order. Its flaw is a cramped lower stack: the body copy, badges and CTA are packed tight, and the CTA sits close to the bottom edge while there is spare room at the top.
